title: LAHORI_PLAYZ
description: It enables low-end devices to achieve playable frame rates (at least 15 FPS) while boosting high-end systems to over 200 FPS
body: This modpack adds mods which will add smoothness in your minecraft client.By downloading and running this modpack in your minecraft,if you have a low end devive or any old device which cannot even run minecraft at the lowest setting this modpack will enhance the FPS and can even give you at least 15FPS or if you have a high end device this modpack will give you more than 200 FPS
